batch: params.twoTierQd two-tier precision router (2026-09-28) — double Schur base + per-sample 1-ulp chaos probe + QD bigfloat only where the probe fires inside the relevance envelope

design.router: psv.js psvTwoTierChaos: relative movement of the C entries under 1-ulp and 7-ulp k shifts (the v13 discriminator re-aimed as the tier router — a true resonance moves ~(u/gamma)^2 ~ 0, the chain's cancellation floor moves O(1)); escalation re-runs the compliance triple on params.qdCompliance with a cache-free params clone
design.relevanceGate: kRel = omega/vsHalfspace + ln(1/relFloor)/zSourceKm (relFloor 1e-6): chaos beyond it is the dead e^{-k*zs} tail (magnitudes <=1e-25, 15+ orders under the weight band) and is SKIPPED, not escalated — the corrupted dip samples read corrupted-small on the double chain (1e-13 where QD carries 1e-9), so the gate never trusts the probed magnitude
design.deflake: two ulp offsets (u, 7u) — a single-offset probe measured one chaotic-zone sample (HALF@f1.2 k=1.78/km) probing stable once at 0.9 double-vs-QD divergence
design.honesty: QD failure keeps the double ent (never nulls a solvable double sample); broken (null) double triples get the QD retry and count as escalations; absent param = byte-compatible (tests/psv-twotier.test.js locks it)

halffSmokeScan.config: HALF (vs 3.5 / vp 6.0 / rho 2.7) @ f1.2 zs33, complianceAt |C00| double-vs-QD over k 1.0-3.0/km (0.02 step)
halffSmokeScan.measured: double chain departs QD from k~1.56/km (8e-6) growing to ~1.0 across 1.8-2.3/km (the detM dip band: S branch 2.154/km + Rayleigh 2.34/km family — the P1 6000x mechanism), one double null at 2.30/km; beyond k~2.5/km the magnitudes sit <=1e-25 with mild 1e-4 floor jitter (both chains agree to ~1e-5 there — dead weight)
halffSmokeScan.tierMap: escalate 1.48-2.56/km, relevance-skip >=2.60/km (kRel = 2.154+13.8/33 = 2.572/km) — the map lands exactly on the measured divergence band

p1Anchor.driver: tools/broadband/psv-horizontal-anchor.js (three arms: qdCompliance / twoTierQd+schur / schur double vs the injected closed-form halfspace BVP; gate <=1e-2 pre-registered 2026-09-13)
p1Anchor.verdict: twoTier worst 4.25e-6 <= 1e-2 PASS (2400x margin) where the double arm fails 8.34; total wall 85.6s vs full-QD 426.1s = 20.1% (5.0x cut; f0.5 cases 5%, f1.2 28-32%)

layeredEndToEnd.driver: .cache/psv-twotier-layered.js (probe, not committed) — tokyo JIVSM column (zs 73 km, r 198.5 km, dcMomentTensor(185,55,90,Mw7.7)), psvMomentSpectrumAtFrequency dk 0.05/km kMax 2/km, poleWindows:false
layeredEndToEnd.verdict: on the production stack family the double chain is 88-875x off while twoTier reproduces QD to 1e-7 (f1.2) / 6.6e-4 (f0.5) at 42-51% of the QD wall; the layered chaos band is wide (52-56% of samples escalated — the v13 0.70-0.82/km cluster), so the QD cut here is ~2x, not the HALF 5x

costAccount: QD cut vs full-QD: 5.0x on the P1 HALF set, ~2x on the tokyo layered set (wide chaos band); vs the pre-twoTier NOT-EXECUTABLE verdict the anchor-class measurement is now minutes, not days. The probe overhead on non-escalated samples is ~2 extra double compliance evals per k (measured: f0.5 twoTier 4.6-4.7s vs plain double 1.2-1.6s on the P1 lattice)
